children.value: ātmatāmāgate citte tasya kiṃ bādhate katham
sauṣuptīṃ vṛttimāśritya kuru mā kuru vānagha
ye tvāśramocitamapi karma tyājyaemveti manyante tānpratyāha - nādānamiti
akartāpi ca kartāsi yathecchasi tathā kuru
antaḥ śītalatāmeti jño rasena yathā śaśī
pātayāśvathā vā dīrghaṃ kālaṃ dhāraya śailavat
prāpya svāṃ padavīṃ puṇyāṃ yathedaṃ bhramitaṃ jagat
mukta ityucyate yogī turyātītaṃ padaṃ gataḥ

itthaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ tasya turīyasthitimuktvānte videhasya turyātītasthitimāha -
anānandeti

anānandamavasthātrayapadaṃ tadapekṣya turyapadaṃ mahānandamiti
tajjivanmuktasya sadā bhavati

videhamuktau tu anānandasmaraṇāyogāttadapekṣayā
mahattvakalanāyogāttadatītastato'pi muktasturyātītapadaṃ gata ityucyata ityarthaḥ
